creative_direction.name: Plum Velvet Curtain Call
creative_direction.brief: A theatrical still-life: crushed aubergine velvet hangs in soft vertical folds, its pile catching a gentle frontal sheen that fades toward the edges like a house curtain before encore. The flacon is lifted into the upper two-thirds so the lower third becomes a quiet plaque band: brand line, then the name in generous Baskerville capitals centred, then the eau de parfum line, with a thin rule floating between image and text like a curtain rail. Opaque dark glass against plush plum pile reads purely by texture contrast; the gold plate supplies the only warm spark in an otherwise velvet-dark house.
creative_direction.material: crushed aubergine velvet drape with vertical fold sheen
creative_direction.lighting: soft diffused frontal light with gentle velvet sheen gradient, no hard shadows
